text:
maria: FYI after the 06:15 BMC batch in us-central1 ~30% of nodes in rack-r7 fail PXE, GPUs marked unavailable.

kai: Any sample OOB output?

maria: node-7a3 oob snippet: ```
$ oobctl status node-7a3
secureboot: ENFORCED
bootmode: UEFI
attest: FAIL (keystore mismatch)
```

devon: Attest fail + ENFORCED = keystore rotation happened out of order during firmware writes. Seen in a small canary last month.

ops-bot: Deploy-bot: rollout fw-roll-2025-10-12-usc1 -> racks:12/12 status: success.

sam: Impact: autoscaler evicting GPU pods ~-220 GPUs, spill to other regions, rising costs.

kai: Options: (A) rollback firmware on impacted racks, or (B) temporarily relax secureboot to allow PXE, then fix keystore ordering and reapply.

devon: I prefer B for fast recovery. Needs oncall approval. Example: `oobctl set-secboot <node> off --reason "temp-allow-pxe"`

maria: Starting a 2-node canary rollback on r7 to validate.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2025-4873 created. Paging @kai.

sam: Finance note: >4h hit will trigger burst reprovisioning; est +$12k/hr.

kai: If canary succeeds, continue rollback; if not, perform temporary secureboot relax and sequenced roll-forward (keystore -> bios -> bmc) with preflight attest checks.

maria: Canary OK: node-7a3 back, PXE succeeded, scheduler shows GPUs healthy. Proceeding with r7 rollback.

devon: We'll update the rollout runbook to ensure keystore attestation checks and re-order rotation.

ops-bot: Timeline logged: 06:15 rollout -> 06:28 failures -> 06:33 rollback start -> 06:44 canary success.

sam: Please include postmortem and cost breakdown after stabilization.

kai: Good recovery. Gate future rollouts on keystore-attest preflight. :+1:
